clips.title: The story
paras: In the southern Barrens, Brine blesses a vial of pure water for a shaman initiate. Its contents help Islen Waterseer prepare a water sapta for seeing elemental spirits.

Brine guides the initiate through trials of patience and cleansing before sealing the water in the vial. The water holds an uncorrupted elemental purity. Carry it across the Barrens to Islen Waterseer, who keeps watch on a solitary shore. She needs it to brew a water sapta. Without such pure water, a shaman cannot commune with spiritual guardians in places far from the sunbaked flats.
